astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Galaxy NGC 474: Shells and Star Streams
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What's happening to galaxy NGC 474?  The multiple layers of emission appear strangely complex given the relatively featureless appearance of the elliptical galaxy in less deep images.  The cause of the shells is a topic of research, but they are possibly tidal tails related to debris left over from absorbing numerous small galaxies in the past billion years.
